Attaching our remittance advice for the payment we sent on 2027-02-28 (file attached). Due to our treasury batch rules the payment landed in two rails: a GBP transfer to our UK clearing account and an EUR transfer to our Frankfurt collection account. A VAT portion was withheld at source on the EUR leg as required by the receiving bank's tax processing (see notes).

Summary: 
- Total gross settled: EUR 72,450.00 (EUR leg) + GBP 18,900.00 (GBP leg)
- VAT withheld on EUR leg: EUR 12,075.00 (reported as withheld by payer bank)
- Payment references list invoices: INV-2345, INV-2346, INV-2347 (see remittance file)

Please confirm how you would like us to allocate the two incoming funds across the three invoices and whether you need a bank trace from our side for reconciliation. We also need your confirmation of the VAT amounts so our AP team can close the transaction.

Laura / Vanessa — forwarding remittance from OrchidSoft. They sent a split settlement across EUR and GBP, and the EUR leg has a VAT-withheld line. I think we should:

1) Apply the GBP leg to INV-2346 (GBP invoice).
2) Apply the EUR leg proportionally to INV-2345 and INV-2347 and account for the VAT withholding as a tax deduction so AR doesn't overstate revenue.
3) Request a bank trace and SWIFT confirmation from OrchidSoft to confirm value dates.

Can you confirm the preferred ledger treatment (credit note vs withheld tax memo) and whether we should ask for a reissued remittance that maps amounts to invoice line items?

FYI I copied Clara at OrchidSoft so they can provide our request quickly.

Thanks,
Logan

Thanks Logan — reviewed the files. Proposed allocation and accounting notes below: 

Allocation suggestion (based on invoice currency and amounts):
- GBP 18,900.00 -> apply in full to INV-2346 (GBP invoice #2346, net GBP 15,750 + VAT GBP 3,150)
- EUR 72,450.00 gross -> split across INV-2345 (EUR invoice, net EUR 45,000) and INV-2347 (EUR invoice, net EUR 15,375) with remaining balance applied to future credit or reconciled as unapplied if small.

VAT handling:
- Treat the EUR VAT withheld (EUR 12,075.00) as tax withheld at source. We should post a tax withholding memo (contra-tax liability) rather than issue a credit note initially. If OrchidSoft provides official withholding documentation (tax certificate or bank confirmation), we will record the withholding as recoverable (tax credit) if local tax law allows.

Action items for OrchidSoft:
- Please confirm which invoice lines correspond to each remitted line in the PDF (itemized mapping).
- Provide SWIFT / bank trace for each leg so Treasury can match value dates.
- If possible, reissue remittance with explicit invoice-level mapping (helps our AR automation).

I will prepare the provisional ledger entries and hold posting pending the bank trace and withholding certificate. Vanessa, will you run the apply and hold payments marked as "pending withholding" in the ledger?

Laura Bennett
Senior AR Manager — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
